title: Wonderful concept - widget requires review
body: I adore the concept of this app specifically when it comes to its utility as a visual aid when a widget. However, despite creating and ticking my habits they are not being displayed in the weekly format as being completed. Please fix this bug!
author: Donk_95

title: I love this app
body: I really love this app. Originally I used it for a short list of things I really wanted to concentrate on. Now I also use it to track all the small habits / small wins that I would otherwise not realize that I am getting done. It’s made me realise I’m a lot more productive than I thought. Thanks so much!
author: Brw27

title: Would be fun if it allowed me to get premium
body: There’s an issue where you try to get premium but it had a connection issue. I switch off wifi on my phone multiple times. I don’t think it’s it. I have even deleted the app to try again same problem.
author: Karloslaylay
